g.text: Title: VisionAid Carrier Board (stacks on Raspberry Pi 5, 40-pin ribbon)

g.desc: Title: VisionAid Carrier Board (stacks on Raspberry Pi 5, 40-pin ribbon)

g.text: FPGA safety island (Tang Nano 9K) + sensor / haptic interface for the Pi 5 AI path

g.desc: FPGA safety island (Tang Nano 9K) + sensor / haptic interface for the Pi 5 AI path

g.text: J5: Benewake TF-Luna LiDAR (UART 115200, 3.3 V logic, 5 V supply), pointing down

g.desc: J5: Benewake TF-Luna LiDAR (UART 115200, 3.3 V logic, 5 V supply), pointing down

g.text: J8: MPU-6050 IMU module (I2C to the Pi)

g.desc: J8: MPU-6050 IMU module (I2C to the Pi)

g.text: J5 pin 2 -> TF-Luna RXD, pin 3 <- TF-Luna TXD (TF-Luna pin 5 left open = UART mode)

g.desc: J5 pin 2 -> TF-Luna RXD, pin 3 <- TF-Luna TXD (TF-Luna pin 5 left open = UART mode)

g.text: through a 500 mA PTC (protects the Pi 5 V rail). AMS1117 makes +3V3 for sensors, motors, IMU, buttons.

g.desc: through a 500 mA PTC (protects the Pi 5 V rail). AMS1117 makes +3V3 for sensors, motors, IMU, buttons.

g.text: Only 3.3 V-bank pins of the left header are used. *_1V8 pins are on a 1.8 V bank: unused.

g.desc: Only 3.3 V-bank pins of the left header are used. *_1V8 pins are on a 1.8 V bank: unused.

g.text: Pi 5 is powered by a USB-C power bank; this board takes 5 V from the Pi 40-pin header (pins 2/4)

g.desc: Pi 5 is powered by a USB-C power bank; this board takes 5 V from the Pi 40-pin header (pins 2/4)

g.text: Pi 3V3 (pins 1, 17) intentionally NOT connected: this board has its own 3.3 V regulator.

g.desc: Pi 3V3 (pins 1, 17) intentionally NOT connected: this board has its own 3.3 V regulator.

g.text: mounting holes, stacked on 20 mm standoffs above the Pi (clears USB/Ethernet jacks and the active cooler).

g.desc: mounting holes, stacked on 20 mm standoffs above the Pi (clears USB/Ethernet jacks and the active cooler).

g.text: 2x20 pin header + 40-way IDC ribbon to the Pi GPIO header. Board = Pi 5 outline (85 x 56 mm), same

g.desc: 2x20 pin header + 40-way IDC ribbon to the Pi GPIO header. Board = Pi 5 outline (85 x 56 mm), same

g.text: D1 feeds the Tang Nano 9K 5 V pin and blocks back-feed when its own USB-C is plugged in for programming.

g.desc: D1 feeds the Tang Nano 9K 5 V pin and blocks back-feed when its own USB-C is plugged in for programming.

g.text: GPIO2=SDA GPIO3=SCL GPIO14=TXD GPIO15=RXD GPIO17=heartbeat GPIO27=fault-in

g.desc: GPIO2=SDA GPIO3=SCL GPIO14=TXD GPIO15=RXD GPIO17=heartbeat GPIO27=fault-in

g.text: 10k pull-up + 100nF = 1 ms RC filter; FPGA also debounces digitally.

g.desc: 10k pull-up + 100nF = 1 ms RC filter; FPGA also debounces digitally.

g.text: 100R series resistors limit fault current and ringing on the sensor cables.

g.desc: 100R series resistors limit fault current and ringing on the sensor cables.

g.text: J6/J7 go to the coin motors on the left/right harness straps; BZ1 sounds the "check device" alarm.

g.desc: J6/J7 go to the coin motors on the left/right harness straps; BZ1 sounds the "check device" alarm.

g.text: U1 FPGA SAFETY ISLAND (Sipeed Tang Nano 9K)

g.desc: U1 FPGA SAFETY ISLAND (Sipeed Tang Nano 9K)

g.text: outputs OFF while the FPGA boots. 1N4148W diodes clamp motor/buzzer flyback. 3 V coin ERMs run from +3V3.

g.desc: outputs OFF while the FPGA boots. 1N4148W diodes clamp motor/buzzer flyback. 3 V coin ERMs run from +3V3.

g.text: AO3400A logic-level N-MOSFETs (Vgs(th) <= 1.45 V) switched by FPGA 3.3 V PWM. 100k gate pull-downs keep

g.desc: AO3400A logic-level N-MOSFETs (Vgs(th) <= 1.45 V) switched by FPGA 3.3 V PWM. 100k gate pull-downs keep
